title: The Blackcoat's Daughter
review: I liked the plot itself, but it was told in such a slow and visually uninteresting way. There's a drip-feed of details revealed in a {Weapons} style non-linear fashion. It's hard to find much to write about this, which usually means I will forget it.
spoilers: By keeping some detais vague they gave me more to think about after it ended. When exactly did the posession start? Did she dream of her parents death as it happned?
